cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.

stats.notes: Fall 2023 entering class from the 2023-2024 Common Data Set, the newest one Quinnipiac has posted (its Institutional Research page lists 2023-24 as the latest, and the 2024-25 and 2025-26 file names return 404), so no CDS exists for fall 2024 or 2025; the fall 2024 IPEDS counts are in the second statistics row. The residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals: applied 4,880 + 14,389 + 2,054 = 21,323, admitted 3,900 + 11,494 + 1,024 = 16,418, enrolled 566 + 1,208 + 23 = 1,797; the gender rows are a few short of the totals, which the CDS allows. Wait list: 1,736 offered a place, 848 accepted, 516 admitted. Early decision is binding (91 applications, 81 admitted); early action is non-binding (8,861 applications, 8,209 admitted, 1,088 enrolled; C22). SAT 27% (493 students) and ACT 3% (55) of enrollees submitted scores; the CDS prints its SAT/ACT percentile columns in reverse order (for example SAT composite 1280 / 1200 / 1120 under 25th / 50th / 75th), so those figures are not used and the percentile ranges come from IPEDS fall 2024. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; the two score-based columns are blank. Undergraduate enrollment (6,248) is the CDS B1 'Total of all undergraduate students enrolled' (6,208 degree-seeking) and the nonresident count (115) is the B2 degree-seeking undergraduate row; College Navigator shows 6,557 undergraduates and a 12-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio for fall 2024 (the CDS says 11 to 1 for fall 2023).

stats_extra.notes: IPEDS fall 2024 entering class: 23,949 applied, 17,280 admitted, 1,917 enrolled (1,916 full-time + 1 part-time), from the chart data of the NCES IPEDS Data Feedback Report 2025, Figure 1; College Navigator shows the same 23,949 applicants, 72% admitted and 11% of admitted students enrolled. 22% (422 students) of enrollees submitted SAT and 3% (63) ACT (College Navigator). There is no Common Data Set for this year, so the residency split, GPA, wait list and early-round counts are blank. Quinnipiac is test-optional for most majors.
